### Overall Assessment
The response demonstrates competent React testing knowledge with appropriate tooling choices and decent persona embodiment. However, for a TEA challenge specifically requesting "comprehensive" test coverage, the actual tests are too sparse—each category gets one example test rather than thorough coverage. A stronger submission would have 3-5 tests per category, covering the specific scenarios mentioned (inline errors, autocomplete, card formatting, etc.) rather than skeleton examples.
